content.text: "Gunar fõtot loizaibar uskani sarme no aibo, hen to oi no fare, kintu bifod hitare, zar duwara hin aibo.
Ze ei šoṛo okkolor butottu ekzonore honokiye gunar fõtot ṭani loi zade o, henoile hitare golat ḍõr fattor bandi di doriyat felai diya hitalla aro beši bala oibo.
Hetolla tũwara nizor babute hũšiyar taikko.
"Zodi tor báiye tor berudde hosuri gore, toile tui hitare hen no goribolla mana gor. Ar zodi hite mon fira toile tui hitare maf goride.
Zodi ek dinor butore hite hãt bar tor berudde hosuri gore edde hãtobar ai ho, 'Ãi ei oinnaittu firi aišši,' toile hitare tottu maf gori diya foribo."

content: Ar asab okkole malik Isare hodde: "Ãrar iman barai do."

content.text: "Uggwa horoir dana borabor biššaš o zodi tũwarattu take edde ei gassware endilla ho, 'Ei gas, šiyõr udda šoho hãri zai doriyat fuṭgoi,' toile he gaswaye tũwarar hota manibo.
"Ar tũwarar butore endilla hone aso, zar gulame al so otóba sool sora, hite górot aile hoiba 'Tui ehon ai, hána haito bošgai?'
Bolke hitare ki no hoiba ne? 'Ãi ki háiyum hinor entezam gor! Ar zetun ãttu hána haiya no o, hetun kiyail bandi ãre šeba gor! Tarfore tui hána hái faribi!'
He gulame malikor hokum mainne buli ki hitar malike hitare šukuriya zanaibo?
He bafe har hokum mani bade o tũwara ho, 'Ãra niroš gulam, ziyan goribar zimma ãra šude hiyan goijji.'"

content: Doš zon kurus biyaraimma aram oiye
Ehon Isaye Zeruzalem zaibar šomot Sameriya edde Galilor mazottu di giye.
Hibaye hono ek farat góillede šomot došzon kurus biyaraimma manuš hibar sarme foijje. Hitara dure tiyaiye edde,
guzori hodde: "Isa, Malik, ãrare doya goro!"

content.text: "Zo, imam okkolor hãse zai nizore dehogoi."

content: Zaite zaite hitara faksaf oi giyegoi.
Toi hitarar butottu ekzone aram oi giyegoide otfaiyore hite guzori Allar tarif gorat uwafes firi aišše,
edde Isar fõt uite fori Isare šukuriya zanaiye. He manušwa aššilde Sameriyar manuš.

content.text: "Došozon pak saf no o neki? Ar nozon hoṛe?
Ei ofor manušwa sara ki ar honokiye Allare tarif goribolla no ailo?"
"Uṭ edde zagoi! Tor biššaše tore bala goijje!"

content: Ek bar Foroši okkole Allar raijjo hõtte aibo Isare fusar goijje. Isaye zuwabe hodde,

content.text: "Allar raijjor suke deha no za.
Ar manušore o no hoibo, so, Allar raijjo ei zagat ba o zagat, kiyollahoile so, Allar raijjo to tũwarar butore ase."
"En šomoi aibo zẽtte tũwara Adomor Futor šomoir ekkan din dekibolla issa goriba, kintu deha no faiba.
Hẽtte manuš okkole tũwarare hoibo, 'So, Adomor Fut o zagat!' So, 'Adomor Fut ei zagat!' Kintu tũwara heṛe no zaiyo, ba hitarar fisa no loiyo.
Zendilla asmanor ek mikkattu bizoli somkile asmanor nise oinno mikka foijjonto fohor o, Adomor Futor dinot o hendilla oibo.
Kintu ei šob goṭibar age, Adomor Futottu beša beši duk bug gora foribo. Ar ei halor mainše hibare batil goribo.
"Ar Nuh nobir ṭaimot zendilla oiye, Adomor Futor ṭaimot o hindilla oibo.
Manuš okkole há fiya goijje, biya goijje, biyata oiye, ze foijjonto Nuh nobi kištit no gole. Toi bor tuwan aišše edde beggunore šeš gori felaiye.
"He bafe Lutor ṭaimot o hendilla oiye. Hẽtte mainše háiye edde fiye, beisse edde kinne, lagaiye edde banaiye.
Kintu ze din Lut Súdum šohorottu niyoli giyegoi, hedin asmanottu oin edde oini šilor zór fori hitara beggunore dongšo gori felaiye.
"Adomor Fut ze din nizore forhaš goribo, he din o hendilla oibo.
He dinor din zodi honokiye góror sãdor uwore take, ar hitar šomošto zinišfati góror butore take, henoile hite hin loibolla lami no ai ok. Hendilla ze maṛot take, hite górot uwafes firi no ai ok.
Lutor bouwor hota monot gori so!
Ze nizor foran basaito sa, hite hiyan haraibo. Kintu ze foran hara, hite hiyan uddar faibo.
Ãi tũwarare hoir: He raitta ek bisanat duizon takile ekzonore loi za oibo, ar oinno ekzon fori takibo.
Duizon mayafuwain ek ḍeit gĩyur dana dufe. Hentu ekzonore loi za oibo, ar oinno ekzon fori takibo.
(Zodi duizon manuš maṛot take, hentu ekzonore loi za oibo, ar oinno ekzon fori takibo.")

content: Toi sahabi okkole fusar goredde: "Malik, hoṛe goṭibode?" Isaye zuwabe hodde,

content.text: "Mora ga zeṛe, heṛe hawa aiye."
